notes.title: [DEMO] Forbidden Offering Demo 0.1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Thanks so much for your feedback—it's been incredibly helpful.



Here are the patch notes for Demo v0.1.4:

Bug fixed:

Projectile amount ability bugs.

Magnet drop fix.

Quality of Life (QoL) & Balance Changes:

Added magnet drop.

Lenore has been buffed! Increased stats for companion Lenore.

Content & Story:

Added more dialogues. 



I'm continuing to work hard on the next update. Please keep the feedback coming and report any new bugs you find on our Discord or Steam forums.



- The Binah Games Team
